description: This file contains the implementation of a mutable builder class 'ImmutableMetadataBuilder' for creating and manipulating 'ImmutableMetadata' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a fluent API for setting, removing, and building JSON-based metadata representations.

classes.name: ImmutableMetadataBuilder
classes.description: A final class that implements MetadataBuilder, providing a fluent API for constructing ImmutableMetadata objects through manipulation of an internal JsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty instance of ImmutableMetadataBuilder.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ImmutableMetadataBuilder initialized with values from a given JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set various types of key-value pairs (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonFieldDefinition) in the metadata, with an optional predicate filter.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key or a field definition from the metadata.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable collection, applying an optional predicate filter.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the builder (and thus the underlying JSON object) is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the builder.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of JsonField elements for functional operations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableMetadata instance based on the current state of the JsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the internal JsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the internal JsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the class name and the JsonObjectBuilder.
